offers.title: CDDRL Pre-doctoral and Postdoctoral Fellowships
offers.institution: Center on Democracy, Development and the Rule of Law, Stanford University
offers.about: Nine-month residential fellowships (September to June) at Stanford supporting writing and research in residence for pre-doctoral and postdoctoral scholars; CDDRL offers 2-4 fully funded fellowships each academic year.
requirements: Pre-doctoral: enrolled in a doctoral program and at the dissertation write-up stage, through the residency period
Postdoctoral: PhD earned within three years of the fellowship start, or dissertation defense by July 31, 2027

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "research" (required skill) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"academic writing" (required skill) → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."

"at the dissertation write-up stage" (pre-doctoral requirement) → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."

offers.summary: Nine-month residential fellowships at Stanford University, from September to June, for pre-doctoral and postdoctoral scholars working on democracy, development and the rule of law. Fellows spend the year in residence at the Center on Democracy, Development and the Rule of Law, writing and doing research. CDDRL offers two to four fully funded fellowships each academic year.
highlights: Pre-doctoral applicants must be enrolled in a doctoral program and at the dissertation write-up stage through the residency period.
Postdoctoral applicants need a PhD earned within three years of the fellowship start, or a dissertation defense by July 31, 2027.
Onsite in Stanford, United States, for nine months, September to June.
Research and academic writing are the core skills for this fellowship.
